done.title: You're ready to search.
done.openFromTaskbar: Find Kensaku in your taskbar or Dock anytime.
done.closingNote: Esc or clicking outside hides the window — Kensaku keeps running in the tray.
done.quitNote: Closing the window quits Kensaku. Your index is saved, next launch is instant.

scan.onlyFirstTime: Only the first time. After this, every launch is instant.
scan.modelFailedBody: The model files did not download. Keyword search works without them.

folders.title: Where do your files live?
folders.lead: Pick the folders to search. You can change this later.
folders.pickMany: pick as many as you like
folders.pathPlaceholder: Or type a path — ~ works, commas separate several
folders.pickerUnavailable: Folder picker unavailable here — type a path below instead. ({{error}})

ocr.title: Read the text in your images
ocr.lead: Screenshots, scans and photos become searchable. Pick an engine.
ocr.tesseractNote: Fast, clean ASCII text; no download needed. Fallback engine.
ocr.ppocrNote: Recommended. ~6 MB, highest recall on dense UI screenshots, fastest batch throughput.
ocr.indraNote: ~27 MB, 80+ languages, rotated/skewed scans; comparable recall, slightly slower.

mode.title: How should Kensaku open?
mode.lead: You can change this anytime in Settings.
mode.appCard: Normal window in your taskbar. Closing it quits Kensaku.
mode.launcherCard: Press a shortcut to open. Esc or click outside to hide. Lives in the tray.
mode.launcherNote: Closing hides it — Kensaku stays in the tray.
mode.wayland: On Wayland, bind kensaku --toggle as a system shortcut if the key doesn't register.
mode.closingLauncher: Esc or click outside to hide. Find it again in the tray or with your shortcut.
